message.content: The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is the exoplanet **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young B-type star HD 100546 and has a mass of roughly **20–25 Jupiter masses** (about 0.02 solar masses) and a radius of about 2–3 times that of Jupiter. This makes it one of the most massive “planet‑like” objects ever found; its size and mass put it near the boundary between giant planets and brown dwarfs.
